name: Komorebi
source:
Komorebi is a story that focuses on a group of friends who happen to experience visions of their future; and the fears and anxieties they face as they try to find their own path in a life that may be predestined. But they aren't the only ones. Almost everybody on this version of Earth experiences the same, and they all live under the watchful eyes of The Argus Corporation; a superpower that demands social order by ensuring that people live in the moment, rather than letting their visions dictate their actions. In this world, your future can shape you even more than your past.

[From [url=https://klace.itch.io/komorebi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Komorebi》讲述一群朋友的故事：他们开始看见未来的景象，并在试图为自己的人生寻找道路时，面对由此产生的恐惧与焦虑；也许他们的命运早已注定。但经历这一切的不只他们。在这个版本的地球上，几乎所有人都会经历这种现象，而强大的Argus Corporation则时刻监视着他们，力求维持社会秩序，让人们活在当下，而不是任由未来幻象支配行动。在这个世界里，未来甚至比过去更能塑造一个人。

[来源：[url=https://klace.itch.io/komorebi]Itch.io[/url]]
